exposure: Randomized into two groups: task-trainer training vs. no training
cohort: 33 Obstetrics and Gynecology, Family Medicine, and General Surgery residents at three hospitals
finding: Residents who received simulation-based training in addition to didactic education performed significantly better in all procedural aspects of cesarean section and hemorrhage management on a high-fidelity simulator.
mod_finding: The intervention group, who received simulation-based training, showed significantly better performance in cesarean delivery and hemorrhage management.
